text:
lucy: quick note from onboarding support: new users hitting confusing errors in sample apps. go sdk prints "Error: auth failed" for 403s while python raises PermissionDeniedError. folks aren't sure what to do.

raj: yikes. we need a consistent mapping and clear remediation hints. 401 != 403 in intent.

sam: proposal: canonical intents: authentication, authorization, rate_limit. surface typed exceptions AuthenticationError, PermissionDenied, RateLimitError across SDKs.

marta: agree on intent names, but keep language-idiomatic types. docs should show the common token names too.

owen: quick mapper sketch (pseudo):
case 401 -> AuthenticationError("token invalid or expired", retryable=true)
case 403 -> PermissionDenied("missing scope inference.write")
case 429 -> RateLimit("quota exceeded", retry_after)
case 409 -> ConflictError("write conflict")

raj: please ensure message copy includes one actionable hint. 401 -> refresh creds; 403 -> check scopes/role; 429 -> backoff with Retry-After.

lucy: sampleapp README currently prints raw stack traces. change that to show user-facing message + suggested fix.

sam: also add telemetry keys: error_intent and error_code so support/ops can alert on spikes and link traces.

marta: docs table idea: HTTP code | intent | SDK exception | user-visible text | telemetry. separate whats shown to users vs what we log.

owen: small ask: normalize noisy upstream bodies in hosted api when safe (eg upstream 403 but body says rate_limit) so sdk behavior is deterministic. keep original payload in logs.

lucy: on quickstart: currently auto-provisioned api key has minimal scopes and first-run write calls hit 403. Either expand first-run scopes or add explicit CTA to upgrade.

sam: i'll draft PR with mapping table + sampleapp snippets showing how to catch and display typed errors (short snippet in python and js).

marta: SDK owners need a PR template: mapping table, example messages, telemetry spec, tests. add unit tests asserting message contains actionable hint.

devex-bot: Ticket created: DEVEX-1873 "Unify SDK error intents and copy" assigned to @sam, @marta. https://tickets.example/DEVEX-1873

sam: timeline: draft + sampleapp patch this sprint, sdk changes next sprint. pinging SDK owners after PR.

owen: quick win: central docs page /docs/error-mapping.md as canonical source of truth.

lucy: thanks everyone. this should reduce onboarding tickets. :thumbsup:
